mode.title: Mode
mode.description: shop = one record per seller. reference = probe the endpoint and report what it yielded, including the 200-with-error-body case.

shops.title: Shops
shops.description: Any of: a username (samsung.official), a numeric shop ID (52635036), a shop URL (/shop/52635036), a storefront URL (/samsung.official), or a PRODUCT URL (…-i.<shopId>.<itemId>) - the shop ID is read straight out of it, so output from the Shopee Flash Sale Monitor can be fed in directly.

country.title: Country site
country.description: Which Shopee site to query. A shop only exists on its own country site.

tlsProfile.title: Preferred TLS profile
tlsProfile.description: Optional. Tried first, then the rest of the ladder. All four answered 200 during recon; this is a tuning knob, not a requirement.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Recommended for larger runs. Shopee gates most of its API at the load balancer; if GATED records appear, a residential exit IP is the first thing to try.
